status: NOT VALIDATED. Assumptions for a labelled sensitivity only, written 2026-10-21. Rates must be checked against a real contract note before any decision. The backtest harness default (SIM.slippageBps = 5 per leg) is unchanged.

futures.label: Nifty index futures (near month)
futures.note: Cost in index points per unit: 2 × spread + STT on the sell leg + exchange, SEBI and stamp on notional + (2 × brokerage + GST) / lot size. STT 0.05% of the sell-side value is an ASSUMED post-Budget-2026 rate. At an index of 25,000 the total is about 16.8 points.

atmOption.label: At-the-money weekly Nifty option, bought (delta 0.5)
atmOption.note: Costs in premium rupees per unit, converted to index points by dividing by delta (the index move needed to pay them back). Premium = 0.5% of the index. STT 0.15% of the sell-side premium is an ASSUMED rate. THETA IS NOT MODELLED: the largest cost of holding a bought option, so this model is optimistic. At an index of 25,000 the total is about 6.1 points.
